import ast,datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,random,re,runpy,sys,time,types

def guard(event,args):

        raise RuntimeError("External effects forbidden in isolated adjacent tests")

        raise RuntimeError("Environment file read forbidden")
sys.addaudithook(guard)
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("src").resolve()))

before=[{"path":p,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths]
print(json.dumps({"source_hashes":before,"scope":"16 exact existing test functions; worker/proxy/review-delta AST isolation and actual pure completeness/validation/taxonomy bodies"}),flush=True)
worker=types.ModuleType("isolated_worker_failure")
worker.__dict__.update(datetime=datetime.datetime,timedelta=datetime.timedelta,re=re,os=os,STATUS_ERROR="error",STATUS_PENDING="pending",SOURCE_YANDEX_BUSINESS="yandex_business")

    raise AssertionError("Test must provide fake dependency")

    setattr(worker,name,deny_dependency)

assert len(completeness_nodes)==2
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__",names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")],level=0)]+completeness_nodes,type_ignores=[])),paths[4],"exec"),worker.__dict__)

names.update({"_preflight_yandex_proxy","_proxy_preflight_diagnostic_reason","_mark_proxy_result","_process_yandex_reviews_delta_task"})
nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(pathlib.Path(paths[0]).read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names]
assert len(nodes)==len(names)
future=ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__",names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")],level=0)
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[future]+nodes,type_ignores=[])),paths[0],"exec"),worker.__dict__)
worker.get_db_connection=lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError("Test must supply fake DB"))
test_names={"test_validate_parsing_result_marks_sparse_apify_yandex_payload_as_failure","test_validate_parsing_result_keeps_non_apify_sparse_yandex_payload_as_success","test_validate_native_yandex_rejects_incomplete_review_collection","test_validate_parsing_result_marks_closed_apify_yandex_business_as_failure","test_native_yandex_error_falls_back_and_preserves_both_failures","test_native_and_apify_exceptions_return_honest_fallback_error","test_queue_transient_parse_retry_accepts_apify_sparse_quality_gap","test_queue_transient_parse_retry_accepts_apify_timeout","test_apify_empty_dataset_stops_after_small_dedicated_retry_budget","test_effective_apify_timeout_sec_switches_to_slow_lane_after_timeout_retry"}
test_names.update({"test_proxy_preflight_accepts_exact_yandex_organization","test_proxy_preflight_rejects_limited_body","test_reviews_delta_task_uses_native_boundary_without_full_fallback","test_reviews_delta_apify_fallback_is_bounded_and_applied_as_delta","test_reviews_delta_native_only_runs_directly_without_proxy","test_reviews_delta_native_only_never_falls_back_to_apify"})

ns={"worker":worker}
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=tests,type_ignores=[])),paths[3],"exec"),ns)
for node in tests:
    patch=pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    try:
        ns[node.name](*([patch] if node.args.args else []))
    finally:
        patch.undo()
    print(json.dumps({"test":node.name,"status":"PASS"}),flush=True)
for item in before:
    assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(item["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item["sha256"]
print(json.dumps({"tests_passed":16,"full_worker_imported":"worker" in sys.modules,"source_hashes_unchanged":True}))
